record.title: Compare one synthetic read completion and stop at the next stock access
record.intent: Test the smallest load-emulation primitive and the FPGA DNA consumer sequence without completing an identity.
requirements: Preserve stock APK and library bytes; change only the exact captured load destination register and PC once.
Admit only read32 at offset 0x4048, stock PC 0x270604 and opcode b9400109.
Explicitly label test values as synthetic and stop before completing any second hardware access.
Do not access physical instruments, modify host policy or globally disable security controls.
acceptance: Validate 32-bit load zero extension and unchanged other registers with an independent private control.
Compare fresh stock runs for responses zero and 0x11223344, recording original requests and both faults or explicit negative.
Check whether stock code stores the supplied first word and reaches the statically predicted read at 0x4044.
Preserve integrity, policy limits, complete teardown and system_server stability evidence.
